player_prompt.intro:
I Player {player_id} i Chopsticks ah ka tel. I turn ah, i hnuai zinga pakhat i thlang:
  + Attack:  '[attack M O]'  where M=i kut (0 emaw 1), O=dawt kut (0 emaw 1).
    - Dawt kut a chhiar a pung i kut a zât aia; a nih chuan 5 aia tam a nih chuan 0 a ni.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  i kut zawng zawng a theh darh L leh R ah (L+R = i kut zawng zawng).
He command zinga pakhat chiah i rawn chhawn.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: A khingpui kut {opp_idx} chu a thi tawh.
invalid_move.split_sum: Split hi {total} a ni tur a ni.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Split-in i kut chanvo a thlak ngei ang.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Tichhuak a dik lo. “[attack M O]” emaw “[split L R]” hi hman rawh.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} in P{opp_id} kut {opp_idx} a bei: a kut a zât aia {opp_val} aia {new_val} ah a pung.
game_action.split: P{player_id} in [{L}, {R}] ah a theh darh.

outcome.win: A hmêlma kut pahnih a thi ve.
outcome.draw: A hawi chin chu a thleng ta.
